authority: Static House Tang administrative program rules. This file registers lawful program templates and treasury-safety policy; it does not prove that any campaign program has been accepted or opened.

treasury_safety.rule: A new discretionary House program may receive at most the registered fraction of cash remaining after the protected stable-expense reserve. Opening a program reserves no money and spends nothing by itself.

field_preparation.rule: An explicitly requested House Tang campaign-preparation stage may load at most seven days of departure food and fodder from exact House stores. It may form already-conserved Tang Wei personal-force manpower and issue only exact registered stock. Missing equipment remains a persisted shortfall rather than being manufactured by narration.

sword_manor_initiates.intake_rule: House-requested intake may admit only conserved screened applicants into the Sword Manor military force through current physical training/replacement throughput. Housing, instructors, ranges, water, food, medical support, assessment, equipment and standards govern intake; there is no fixed personnel cap and no outsider instructional enrollment.

sword_manor_officer_cadre.representation_rule: Sword Manor army commander and deputy are named full characters outside disciple fighting strength. Internal 1,000/500 officers are conserved members of their disciple rank; 100-man and below remain aggregate unless salient.

sword_manor.rule: current conserved permanent military-force snapshot, not an authorized maximum or mobilization pool

standing_establishment.command_count_rule: army/unit commander and deputy excluded from fighting troop numbers; internal 1,000/500 commanders are conserved inside their fighting ranks.

four_bastion_corps.rule: permanent Four Bastion Corps nested as one subordinate command inside the unified House Tang Field Army; outer-perimeter defense is their default home doctrine, not separate-army status or a deployment prohibition
